name: push_from_behind
code:
def primitive(obj, target, p):
    obj_x, obj_y = obj['center']
    obj_width = obj['width']
    
    if target is None:
        target_x = obj_x + p['default_push_distance'] * cos(p['default_push_direction'])
        target_y = obj_y + p['default_push_distance'] * sin(p['default_push_direction'])
    else:
        target_x, target_y = target['center']
    
    push_vec_x = target_x - obj_x
    push_vec_y = target_y - obj_y
    push_angle = atan2(push_vec_y, push_vec_x)
    push_dist = hypot(push_vec_x, push_vec_y)
    
    start_standoff = obj_width / 2.0 + p['behind_standoff']
    start_x = obj_x - start_standoff * cos(push_angle)
    start_y = obj_y - start_standoff * sin(push_angle)
    
    approach_height = obj['top_z'] + p['approach_height']
    push_height = obj['top_z'] + p['push_height']
    
    open_gripper()
    
    move(start_x, start_y, approach_height, yaw=push_angle, tilt=0.0, speed=0.2)
    
    move(start_x, start_y, push_height, yaw=push_angle, tilt=0.0, speed=0.1)
    
    contact_x = obj_x - (obj_width / 2.0 - p['engagement_depth']) * cos(push_angle)
    contact_y = obj_y - (obj_width / 2.0 - p['engagement_depth']) * sin(push_angle)
    
    move(contact_x, contact_y, push_height, yaw=push_angle, tilt=0.0, speed=0.05)
    
    total_push = push_dist + p['overtravel']
    num_segments = max(1, int(total_push / p['segment_length']))
    num_segments = min(num_segments, 35)
    
    for i in range(1, num_segments + 1):
        progress = i / float(num_segments)
        current_dist = progress * total_push
        
        push_x = contact_x + current_dist * cos(push_angle)
        push_y = contact_y + current_dist * sin(push_angle)
        
        move(push_x, push_y, push_height, yaw=push_angle, tilt=0.0, speed=p['push_speed'])
    
    final_x, final_y, final_z = tcp()
    move(final_x, final_y, approach_height, yaw=push_angle, tilt=0.0, speed=0.2)
    
    return True
description: Pushes the object from directly behind toward the target with the gripper open, using the flat hand surface. This ensures straight-line motion and reliable contact, with engagement depth controlling how firmly the gripper contacts the object edge before the main push.
check: object moved close to target center (within 3-4 cm)

behind_standoff.meaning: distance behind object center to start approach

engagement_depth.meaning: how far into the object edge the gripper pushes before the main push

approach_height.meaning: height above object for safe approach

overtravel.meaning: extra distance to push beyond target

default_push_distance.meaning: push distance when no target given

default_push_direction.meaning: push direction when no target given
